title: Calamity Hub
features:
Advanced script developed specifically for the game Flick (FPS), focused on maximizing performance, precision, and reaction time during matches.

It features intelligent systems that assist in detecting and eliminating enemies, providing a strong advantage in fast-paced and intense combat situations.

⚙️ Main Features:
• Aimbot – Highly accurate automatic aiming.
• Aimlock – Locks the crosshair onto the target for better shot control.
• Adjustable FOV – Full customization of the aiming field of view.
• ESP – See enemies through walls with clear position highlights.
• Enemy Detection – Visual assistance when enemies are nearby.

🚀 Benefits:
• Increased accuracy and shot consistency
• Faster reaction time in combat
• Better map awareness and enemy positioning
• Clean, lightweight, and efficient interface
